name: Dialga & Palkia LV.X Constructed Standard Decks

releases.name: Dialga & Palkia LV.X Constructed Standard Decks

description.text: Two ready-built 60-card decks released on 5 July 2007, the same day as the Shining Darkness expansion: Dialga LV.X and Palkia LV.X. Each was guaranteed to hold its Pokémon LV.X, a kind of card that until then had been hard to get. Alongside its legendary Pokémon, the Dialga deck has Ampharos and Mothim and the Palkia deck Gallade and Sandy Cloak Wormadam, and both are rich in strong Trainer cards. Damage counters and markers, a coin and a how-to-play book came with each.
